decision: static React app plus one small API function, not Next.js
why: full control over when an installed app updates, and Pancake shows a static app with a hand-written worker works on this host

decision: append-only ledger with voids for corrections
why: every correction stays visible and traceable, and a double void is blocked by the database

decision: results only from cash-outs minus buy-ins, shown only after a player cashes out
why: the spec forbids guessing winnings from buy-ins

decision: payments tracked as separate entries next to chips
why: lets partial and late payments show as outstanding without changing results

decision: recovery by one-time codes shown at sign-up, no email
why: the spec asks for username and password only, and codes work without any mail service

decision: client-chosen operation ids stored with the response
why: a retried or replayed save returns the same result instead of a duplicate

decision: polling every 2 seconds for live updates
why: pooled database connections cannot push notifications and serverless functions are short-lived

decision: drafts and unsent saves in IndexedDB
why: Pancake's own notes show session storage drafts die when an installed iOS app is killed

decision: per-player hours come from each player's own buy-in and cash-out times
why: the spec forbids using the whole table's duration for a late arrival

decision: did not count local compression as a product speedup
why: Vercel already compresses static files, so the change only makes the local harness match production

decision: kept the players aggregation in Postgres
why: live A/B: all five pairs improved, 447 to 140 ms median, beyond both MADs, identical bodies

decision: did not tune concurrent writes
why: only one 5.2 s outlier in 50 and server time is not observable live

decision: fixed 180-day browser cookie; only session creation sets pb_session
why: Round 26 orchestrator decision: delayed authenticated or logout replies must not replace or clear a newer login; server expiry remains enforced

decision: shared exact money grammar through the PostgreSQL bigint limit
why: accept everyday cents/symbols/grouping without floats, artificial lower caps or losing invalid drafts

decision: visible 60-second discovery with guarded activation and document-release cache retention
why: no forced transaction reload; old live pages keep their hashed assets until they can adopt
evidence: Round 36; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Service worker and updates

decision: keep IndexedDB v2 and previous API request bodies unchanged
why: pinned dc2082b draft/outbox replay and reverse archived-reader checks; do not pretend a running baseline can acquire new idle polling retroactively

decision: combine phone navigation and one contextual action; choose the player explicitly
why: judge M1/M2: four complete rows at 393x659, six at 393x852; no arbitrary-player footer buy-in

decision: atomic latest-receipt Undo appends all money-command voids under one revision and op_id
why: avoid partial paid-entry reversals and undoing newer work; previous APIs and schema remain compatible

decision: load open sessions separately from paginated history and retain highest known revision
why: older unfinished sessions must be pinned even beyond the first 30 history rows

decision: keep the centre Buy-in action for the current open session on every tab; New session otherwise
why: position memory and safe hierarchy; Close and Reopen stay in Menu, with one additional close control tap

decision: preserve the recorded timer after first-buy-in Undo and expose Correct times in its toast
why: the approved spec calls for explicit timing correction with visible history rather than silently resetting recorded time

decision: offer eight seconds of available Undo time and keep completion feedback bound to its originating session
why: pause while touched/focused/editing without restarting the budget; a late response cannot offer another session’s timing editor

decision: bound retained-cache entries using complete release manifests and immutable initial legacy inventories
why: collect later contamination; preserve shared/live assets and defer entry pruning when a known live release lacks asset metadata

decision: recover initial entry only after actual script or module failure, with the existing two-navigation budget
why: a healthy 18-second download must not be cancelled by elapsed time alone

decision: retain deferral for unmodified 30209c1 windows even after a quiet interval or foreground return
why: waiting worker observes ACTIVATE but no old-controller fetches during a genuine held POST; activation changes existing controlled clients before activate so removing claim is insufficient
evidence: scripts/verify-update-review.ts R3; W3C Activate algorithm; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md

decision: retain complete release manifests independently of cache existence while documents/workers reference them
why: failed installs prune too; unknown client metadata uses a fixed first-observed URL fallback instead of disabling entry pruning; supersedes Round40 metadata deferral
evidence: public/sw.js; tests/pwa.test.ts; R7 failed-install browser proof

decision: ready-to-close card supplements Menu while footer keeps one meaning
why: two-control balanced close without removing exact revision/discrepancy checks

decision: edge-emulating proxy and per-render Activity time formatter; no Activity window or batched defaults
why: five paired long wins are retained only if small and standard guards pass
